name: Matthew Turner
source:
[i]"I swore revenge on vampires, and so I became a hunter."[/i]

[b]Occupation:[/b] Vampire hunter
[b]Interest:[/b] Reading
[b]Weapon:[/b] Bow and Arrow

A fledgling vampire hunter charged with the protection of Oedeo. He's smart, but has a timid and pessimistic personality, he and Baron are a well-balanced hunter duo.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/redbell/english/characters/?page=matthew]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
